text:
Doctor's name: Khun PONGSAKORN.
Removal of old breast implants due to suspected rupture.
For personal reasons, I could not undergo the procedure under general anesthesia.
I do not tolerate certain types of anesthesia well, and even tooth extraction is life-threatening.
Clinics and hospitals (I consulted in 4 places) refused to use local anesthesia.     In addition, I wanted the incision to be made along the old scar around the areola, and not under the breast, but the implants were very large. This surgeon was the only one who communicated with me properly, listened to my wishes, and did everything perfectly. He made incisions over the old scar and removed the implants under local anesthesia.
✅️Quick and painless.
✅️Without new scars.
✅️The cost was extremely reasonable for me, several times lower than anywhere else. He has a perfectly clean and advanced operating room on the second floor with all the necessary equipment. He has many years of experience behind him and has done many things hundreds of times. His assistants have been working for 18 years and are very experienced. Linens and "patient clothing," instruments, optimal, safe anesthesia - he doesn't relax and takes care of us. He is a man who changes people's lives. I am also sure that he has the best-invisible sutures in the world and that he performs Botox injections flawlessly. He is a master of his craft, very passionate about his work, a true professional, and a very good person.
You can trust him with your secrets. He is very professionally honest. A heart of gold and golden hands are what distinguishes this doctor.

text:
The doctor is lovely and very kind. She doesn't try to sell you any courses or push anything on you. The nurses and assistants are also lovely, always smiling, cheerful, and speak very well.
I've had two nose surgeries with the doctor. It's not that the doctor is bad or unskilled; it's just that my original nose shape was very thin. In the first series, the skin around my nose could only stretch a certain amount.😅 That's what the doctor said. But the result is very natural; no one can tell unless you tell them. So, I went for the second series, and this time the skin around my nose could stretch even more. Now I have the high nose bridge I wanted!👍
I always get Botox injections with the doctor. I've had injections elsewhere before, and my eyes looked slanted and I always looked shocked. But here, the doctor injects very well. My eyes don't look stiff or shocked at all. The Botox package is all-inclusive; if you're not satisfied or it's not tight enough, you can come back for unlimited refills.
I also got filler injections for my nasolabial folds with the doctor. At first, the doctor didn't want to inject them, saying they were still okay. I had to persist, and then the doctor agreed!5555 The filler is definitely authentic; it doesn't migrate, sag, or feel hard or overflowing. It's incredibly smooth.
This isn't just the doctor; this is the father who gave birth to my new face! ❤️
